message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && cat > /tmp/make_hook.py <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('src/md4c.c').read_text()
s=s.replace('#include <string.h>','#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdio.h>')
s=s.replace('static int
md_start_new_block(MD_CTX* ctx, const MD_LINE_ANALYSIS* line)
{
    MD_BLOCK* block;', 'static int
md_start_new_block(MD_CTX* ctx, const MD_LINE_ANALYSIS* line)
{
    if(line->type >= MD_LINE_TABLE) { fprintf(stderr,"BADSTART type=%d size=%u\n", line->type, (unsigned)ctx->size); abort(); }
    MD_BLOCK* block;')
Path('/tmp/md4c_hook_abort.c').write_text(s)
PY
python3 /tmp/make_hook.py
clang --version | head -1
clang -O1 -g -fsanitize=fuzzer,address,undefined -I src test/fuzzers/fuzz-mdhtml.c /tmp/md4c_hook_abort.c src/md4c-html.c src/entity.c -o /tmp/fuzz_hook && echo built
mkdir -p /tmp/corpus_md && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import struct
seeds=[b'',b'a
|---|
b
',b'|a|
|-|
|b|
',b'> |a|
> |-|
> |b|
',b'- |a|
  |-|
  |b|
',b'> [!NOTE]
> |a|
> |-|
> |b|
',b'[x]: y
---
']
for i,s in enumerate(seeds):
 Path(f'/tmp/corpus_md/s{i}').write_bytes(struct.pack('<II',0x80f0f,0)+s)
PY
/tmp/fuzz_hook -max_total_time=120 -artifact_prefix=/tmp/artifact_ /tmp/corpus_md > /tmp/fuzz_hook.out 2> /tmp/fuzz_hook.err; rc=$?; echo RC=$rc; tail -80 /tmp/fuzz_hook.err; ls -l /tmp/artifact_* 2>/dev/null | tail
